text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Should I be gentle and care for them, or 
should I be strict? What should I do...?
choice_data_list: Give her plenty of care and comfort

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I took good care of them and focused on 
treating their injury.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
However, <chrname> was unable to move her body, and 
seemed to have fallen into a deep slump...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
There's no time to stand still! Hardening 
my heart, I decided to treat <chrname> with strict 
discipline.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
However, as a result of pushing herself 
too hard, her injury only worsened...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Then, as if by a miracle, the injury 
healed completely, and training went 
great!!
